finding: Library versions change results (solver defaults, spline code); a mismatch must be visible
evidence_value: pinned versions compared with installed ones; 12 packages listed
decision: Pin versions in requirements.txt and print a pinned-versus-installed table in §0
alternatives_rejected: Unpinned install; conda lock file (no gain for a pure-pip stack)
check_note: Re-run: table printed, no missing package, importability of sklearn estimators asserted

finding: One shared integer seed would couple random steps (adding a bootstrap call shifts the CV folds)
evidence_value: SEED_MASTER=20261011; evalkit.derive_seed(master, *tags) = SeedSequence([master, crc32(tag)...]); 10 robustness seeds from tags
decision: Derive one named seed per random consumer with evalkit.derive_seed (SeedSequence over master seed and crc32 of the tags); hold-out generated once and stored
alternatives_rejected: Global np.random.seed; ad-hoc per-call seeds; positional SeedSequence.spawn (stream moves when a consumer is added)
check_note: Re-derivation identical, consumers distinct, master seed and tag order matter (asserts)

finding: Raw files are the provenance anchor; any edit, truncation or line-ending change must be detected

decision: Re-hash all XPT files at the start of §0 and fail hard on a mismatch; .gitattributes marks *.xpt binary and the manifest LF
alternatives_rejected: Trust git alone; check file sizes only
check_note: Independent hashlib check run; all 16 digests equal the manifest

evidence_value: sections as jupytext percent scripts, executed copies in notebooks/executed/

alternatives_rejected: Free-form notebooks; one monolithic notebook from the start
